facts.text: The hotel is in Piantini and the Financial District of Santo Domingo, a hub of business and entertainment.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in the vibrant hub of business and entertainment, InterContinental Real Santo Domingo is situated in Piantini and the Financial District

facts.text: The hotel is about four miles from the Colonial Zone.
facts.excerpt: situated in Piantini and the Financial District, just four miles from the Colonial Zone.

facts.text: The hotel is near key corporate centers, shopping and dining destinations.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel is conveniently located near key corporate centers, shopping, and dining destinations.

facts.text: The outdoor pool is an L-shaped infinity-edge pool on the hotel's third floor.
facts.excerpt: Infinity edge pool in L shape in the heart of the city, located on the 3rd floor of the hotel.

facts.text: Around the infinity pool guests can soak in a Jacuzzi and relax in a cabana with a drink or light bite from Blu Pool Bar.
facts.excerpt: Take a dip in our spectacular infinity-edge pool with stunning vistas or soak in a soothing Jacuzzi. Relax in a cabana with a beverage or light bite from Blu Pool Bar

facts.text: Spa InterContinental offers massages, facials and body treatments, with six treatment rooms, two Finnish saunas, two Turkish baths and a Jacuzzi.
facts.excerpt: Rejuvenate at SPA InterContinental, where massages, facials, and body treatments await. With six treatment rooms, two Finnish saunas, two Turkish baths, a Jacuzzi

facts.text: The 24/7 fitness center shares a floor with the pool and spa and has natural light and panoramic views.
facts.excerpt: Our 24/7 fitness center shares a floor with our pool and spa, boasts unparalleled amenities, natural lighting, and panoramic views.

facts.text: Club InterContinental Rooms are on floors 19 to 22, with views of the Caribbean and the city skyline.
facts.excerpt: Club InterContinental Rooms, located on floors 19-22, boasting breathtaking vistas of the Caribbean and city skyline.

facts.text: Club InterContinental Rooms include access to the InterContinental Club, with an open bar of wine, beer and spirits.
facts.excerpt: With exclusive access to the InterContinental Club, enjoy an open bar with wine, beer, and spirits.

facts.text: The Executive Lounge has Caribbean Sea views, complimentary breakfast and evening cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy breathtaking Caribbean Sea views, complimentary breakfast, and evening cocktails.

facts.text: Rooms have memory foam beds, blackout curtains and skyline views.
facts.excerpt: With memory foam beds, blackout curtains and skyline views

facts.text: Accommodations include Classic Rooms, Club InterContinental Rooms, One Bedroom Suites and Suite 1.
facts.excerpt: Select dates Suite 1One Bedroom SuiteClassic RoomsClub InterContinental Rooms

facts.text: The hotel's two full-service restaurants are The Market and NAU Sushi Lounge.
facts.excerpt: Savor the culinary delights of our two full-service restaurants. The Market and NAU Sushi Lounge

facts.text: Blu Pool Bar is a third-floor roof terrace lounge set amid the infinity edge pool, with skyline views, tapas by day and cocktails in the evening.
facts.excerpt: Ascend to the third floor and immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of our roof terrace lounge, offering breathtaking skyline views. Nestled amidst an infinity edge pool

facts.text: The Market, in the main lobby, has a lively exhibition kitchen and serves breakfast, lunch, dinner and late-night dishes.
facts.excerpt: The modern ambiance and lively exhibition kitchen add to the appeal of this innovative restaurant concept

facts.text: NAU Sushi Lounge in the main lobby serves fresh sushi and sashimi from the bar with handcrafted cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Savour fresh sushi and sashimi from the bar paired with a handcrafted cocktail.

facts.text: The hotel's lush gardens and open-air banquet halls host weddings, from intimate ceremonies to grand celebrations.
facts.excerpt: From intimate ceremonies to grand celebrations, our lush gardens and open-air banquet halls provide the perfect setting for your special day.

facts.text: Parking is complimentary for registered guests, on three levels.
facts.excerpt: 3 levels of parking. No parking charge for registered guests.

facts.text: The minimum check-in age is 18.
facts.excerpt: **Minimum check-in age**: 18

facts.text: Pets are not allowed; only service animals are allowed.
facts.excerpt: No pets allowed; only service animals allowed.

facts.text: Las Americas International Airport is about 32 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Las Americas International Airport (SDQ), approximately 19.88 miles away (32 kilometers) from the hotel

facts.text: Piantini is described as the city's trendiest district.
facts.excerpt: Step outside and immerse yourself in Piantini, the city’s trendiest district.

facts.text: The Lobby Bar is said to stand apart for its distinctive mixology.
facts.excerpt: The Lobby Bar at InterContinental Santo Domingo stands apart for its distinctive mixology.

contradictions.note: p1 says four miles from the Colonial Zone; p1 FAQ says 3.11 miles (5 km)

sources.excerpt: just four miles from the Colonial Zone.
